newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim surges in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim surges in heavy trade.

text.p: Polish industrial and trading firm surged 9.9 percent in heavy trade and analysts said large investors were buying such large-cap fundamentally sound stocks after the market's 14.6-percent drop over much of October.
"It seems institutional buying, including foreign buying, has returned," one trader said.

Analysts said Elektrim, whose day-high turnover was at 12.2 million zlotys, may have been helped by Tuesday's winning of a 19-million-zloty contract and Merrill Lynch's recent keeping of its accumulate rating. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
